title: Error on nested @property and @position-try rules
author: ChrisJr404
summary: `@property` and `@position-try` preludes returned early in NestedRuleParser::parse_prelude, skipping the allowed_in_style_rule() check, so nesting them in a style rule was silently accepted (and emitted as invalid CSS when nesting is preserved). The PR lets them fall through to the check: error in strict mode, warning with errorRecovery. This matches exactly what the maintainer asked for in #962.
evidence: Master: `.foo{ @property --a {...} color:red }` -> `.foo{@property --a{...}color:red}`, exit 0, with and without --error-recovery. devongovett on #962 (2025-04-19): 'they should probably both error unless errorRecovery is enabled in which case they should both warn. I don't think auto "fixing" errors is a good idea.' src/parser.rs:731-739 still has the early `return Ok(...)`. Only PR for #962. Reviewer: confirm @position-try is indeed not allowed nested per css-anchor-position, and that nesting inside @media inside a style rule is also caught.
